knowledge:
- key_parameters: sample=Path to the input SNV VCF file (gzipped) ;; sv_sample=Path to the input SV VCF file (gzipped) ;; chromosomes=Vector of chromosome names to analyze (e.g., c("19")) ;; inputFiles=Vector of paths to rare variant text files generated by chromosomeVis ;; sampleNames=Vector of sample names corresponding to the input files
- alternatives: The documentation mentions the original RareVariantVis (Stokowy et al., 2016) as its predecessor, which this version (RareVariantVis 2) significantly extends.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing whole genome sequencing (WGS) data from a single sample or multiple samples (e.g., trios/families) to identify, annotate, and visualize rare single nucleotide and structural variants across chromosomes.
- pitfalls: The package specifically supports VCF files generated by speedseq and GATK variant callers; using VCFs from other callers may cause compatibility issues. Users must ensure that the input files for interactive visualization (rareVariantVis and multipleVis) are the exact text files output by chromosomeVis.

workflows.name: single_sample_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify, annotate, and visualize rare single nucleotide and structural variants from a single genome sample.
workflows.stages: 1. Load the RareVariantVis and DataRareVariantVis packages ;; 2. Define paths to the input SNV and SV VCF files ;; 3. Run chromosomeVis to perform variant discovery, annotation, and static visualization ;; 4. Run rareVariantVis to generate an interactive HTML visualization of the rare variants
workflows.code:
library(RareVariantVis)
library(DataRareVariantVis)
sample = system.file("extdata", "CoriellIndex_S1.vcf.gz",
    package = "DataRareVariantVis")
sv_sample = system.file("extdata", "CoriellIndex_S1.sv.vcf.gz",
    package = "DataRareVariantVis")
chromosomeVis(sample=sample, sv_sample=sv_sample,
    chromosomes=c("19"))
rareVariantVis("RareVariants_CoriellIndex_S1.txt",
               "RareVariants_CoriellIndex_S1.html",
               "CorielIndex")

workflows.name: multiple_sample_visualization
workflows.intent: Simultaneously visualize rare variants from multiple genome samples in a single interactive plot.
input: RareVariants_CoriellIndex_S1.txt (rare variants text file for sample 1)
RareVariants_Coriell_S2.txt (rare variants text file for sample 2)
workflows.stages: 1. Define the input file paths and sample names ;; 2. Run multipleVis to generate a joint interactive HTML visualization for a specific chromosome
workflows.code:
inputFiles = c("RareVariants_CoriellIndex_S1.txt",
               "RareVariants_Coriell_S2.txt")
sampleNames = c("CoriellIndex_S1", "Coriell_S2");
multipleVis(inputFiles, "CorielSamples.html", sampleNames, "19")
